correctness.rationale: Each round at most doubles row support, so three rounds are necessary. A second-layer support of size two, caused by a shared edge, cannot participate in success: even the union with a size-four support is too small. Otherwise each second-layer row has four coefficients 1/4, and the last layer succeeds exactly by pairing complementary supports. Contracting the four first-layer pairs gives a loopless 2-regular multigraph. The doubled-pair case has 3 partitions times 2² ways to attach endpoints; the simple-cycle case has 3 cycles times 2⁴ ways, giving 12 and 48, leaving 45 overlaps among 105 matchings. The respective complement graphs on original vertices are K4,4 and a disjoint pair of K2,2, giving 24 and 4 final matching choices. Thus 480 of 11025 pairs complete any fixed first matching, and the quotient is 32/735. Reviewed the frozen verification notes and integer path-count verify.py; the support argument covers the full finite sample space without a new execution.
